series_description: The cosmic visual storybook and planetary expedition chronicles of The Stardust Engine aboard the U.S.S. Aethelgard. Picking up during Movement IV of the 15-minute progressive rock suite 'Escape Velocity (Ad Astra)', Ryan, Cassidy, and Holly O'Connell—alongside twin pilots Tyler and Evan Wright—leave the fluorescent Cage of Earth behind and step onto Caelum-IV, a tidally locked, purple-ocean moon orbiting the ringed super-Jovian Vespera (Kepler-442c) whose living biosphere pulses at 120.0 BPM.
